def_en: 1) to break through or down or over, burst, breach
1a1) to break or burst out (from womb or enclosure)
1a2) to break through or down, make a breach in
1a5) to break up, break in pieces
1a9) to burst open 1a10) to spread, distribute
kjv: [idiom] abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.
expl: to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative)
